newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu to Europe in December.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu to Europe in December.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will travel to Portugal, Spain and possibly Ireland in December, Netanyahu's office said on Wednesday.
"Prime Minister Netanyahu will participate in the European conference on security and cooperation which will take place in Portugal on December 3, 1996," his office said in a statement.
The statement said Netanyahu would travel to Madrid to meet Spanish King Juan Carlos on December 4.
It said Netanyahu might visit Ireland on December 5 to meet Irish Prime Minister John Bruton. Ireland is the current head of the European Union troika.

The EU troika, led by Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring, this month visited Syria, Egypt, Jordan and the Palestinian Authority but cancelled a visit to Israel when it objected to troika plans to visit the PLO's Orient House headquarters in Arab East Jerusalem.
Israel captured East Jerusalem in 1967 and annexed it, a move unrecognised by the international community. Palestinians want East Jerusalem for the capital of a future state.

The fate of the city holy to Jews, Moslems, and Christians is to be settled at final status peace talks between Israel and the Palestinians that have not resumed since Netanyahu won Israel's May elections.
